# CMOC supply ramp-up drives cobalt market to its lowest ebb: Cobalt 2024 in review

20th December 2024

 Reported & Edited By 

Didi Bostock

Editor - Energy Transition & Economics

Unprecedentedly strong supply growth from CMOC’s Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) assets culminated in a historically large cobalt supply surplus in 2024, amounting to 37,000 tonnes. “China’s CMOC significantly ramped up cobalt and copper production at its Tenke Fungurume (TFM) and Kisanfu (KFM) sites this year,” said Will Talbot, principal cobalt analyst at Benchmark. “Data […]
